headline: 1 Software Stock to Own for Decades and 2 We Avoid
summary: Software is rapidly reducing operating expenses for businesses. Companies bringing it to life have been rewarded with explosive earnings growth, and the upward trend shows no signs of stopping as the industry has posted a 13.5% gain over the past six months, beating the S&P 500 by 8.6 percentage points.
